a: tileCull culls a group with its own composite by its children's box, though that composite changes the destination outside it
commandBox bounds a group with its own composite by its children, where cullDrawCommands treats it as reaching everywhere
rasterizeTile's `<canvas>` fallback always returns null, after drawing the whole tile
uninstallFakeOffscreenCanvas with no matching install deletes a real OffscreenCanvas
b: A group whose composite clears the destination is bounded by its children, so culling and tiles drop its clearing
textCommand / textCommandFromRuns map a `'bounds'` paint onto the wrong box for centered or right-aligned text with no width
createPaintResources.release stops at the first throwing release and drops the rest
A lazily loaded paint kind's `'bounds'` paint passes through unconverted until the kind lands
